zetaris.role: System of record: append-only Evidence, entities, links, Open Loops, Check-ins and notifications in recall_data.app, read and written through the JDBC repository

meterless_nightshift.role: Every model call goes Recall -> ModelGateway -> Nightshift; receipts record requested model, routed model and provider

meterless_hmem.role: Governed memory consulted by the Open Loop Agent; unmodified reference engine vendored in engines/hmem

nvidia.role: Nemotron 3 Ultra makes the Open Loop, Context and Critic decisions, reached only through Nightshift
nvidia.direct_api_usage: none in the application; no direct-provider fallback
